data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for Intercom in-app messaging and help-center integration.
data.what_it_does: Integrates the Intercom SDK for Android, iOS, and Web into a Flutter application. It allows users to view in-app messages, open the help center, and handle customer support conversations.
use_when: You need in-app customer support and chat functionality from Intercom in your app.
You want to display the Intercom help center and articles natively.
avoid_when: You only need local notifications or standard push notifications without Intercom services.
You use a customer support platform other than Intercom.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, and Web platforms.
Wraps the latest native Intercom SDKs for Android and iOS.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration like custom Android Application class setup and iOS permissions.
Some functions are not yet supported on Web.
data.setup_notes: Requires native configuration including extending FlutterFragmentActivity on Android, custom Application class for native SDK initialization, NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription on iOS, and integration with firebase_messaging for push notifications.
